lines.before: **Hard rules:** batch at G3 (triage and diagnose everything, then fix roots). **Two passes:** one large sweep, then ONE short re-sweep over the whole batch (by tier: rule:sweep-tiers) (never per fix - an undamped loop) of whether the fixes broke anything; a third only for a major re-sweep finding.
lines.after: **Hard rules:** batch at G3 (triage and diagnose everything, then fix roots). **Two passes:** one large sweep, then ONE short re-sweep over the whole batch (by tier: rule:sweep-tiers) (never per fix - an undamped loop) of whether the fixes broke anything; a third only for a major re-sweep finding. A high or critical re-sweep finding never carries to the next run: fixed before the PR, or the owner accepts it.
lines.why: a high or critical finding is fixed or accepted, never carried to the next run; the sweep audit enforces it
